shortDescription: A 3-week high-frequency peaking cycle — 4 sessions per week at 70-85% of 1RM with weekly weight increases, commonly adding 15-25 lbs to your bench press
descriptionHtml: A 3-week high-frequency peaking cycle — 4 sessions per week at 70-85% of 1RM with weekly weight increases, commonly adding 15-25 lbs to your bench press
author: Sergey Smolov

exercises.notes: **Base Cycle.** Weight increases +10lb each week on top of these percentages. Adjust the increment in exercise settings if needed.
